hardware_definition_status: measured hardware calibration; not qualified GLM operator or full serving prediction support
device_granularity: one Ascend910_9382 runtime chip; eight two-chip boards / sixteen chips per Atlas800TA3 node

topology_scope.transport_evidence: Same SuperPod metadata; HCCN IP unset; measured cross-host bandwidth exceeds control-plane bond4. Do not infer a general Ethernet/RDMA or cross-SuperPod rate.

gpu.mem_capacity.method: Minimum acl/torch runtime total memory over 16 chips; not free memory and not 128GiB per board.

gpu.mem_bw.method: Median across all 16 devices of median repeated 512MiB Torch copy throughput, counting read plus write.

gpu.mem_bw_empirical_scaling_factor.method: Measured bandwidth already includes utilization; avoid a second arbitrary discount.

gpu.bfloat16_tc_flops.method: Median over 16 chips; 2*M*N*K, M=N=K=4096, torch.mm BF16; measured effective coefficient, not theoretical peak.

gpu.int8_tc_flops.method: Median over 16 chips; 4096-cube torch_npu.npu_quant_matmul, INT8 inputs, unit scale and BF16 output; activation quantization excluded; not theoretical peak.

node.intra_node_bw.unit: bytes/second per runtime chip, single direction
node.intra_node_bw.method: Median pair throughput at 256 MiB under concurrent pairs; maximum of local/cross small-payload medians for effective runtime P2P latency.

node.inter_node_bw.unit: bytes/second per runtime chip, single direction
node.inter_node_bw.method: Median pair throughput at 256 MiB under concurrent pairs; maximum of local/cross small-payload medians for effective runtime P2P latency.

node.p2p_latency.method: Median pair throughput at 256 MiB under concurrent pairs; maximum of local/cross small-payload medians for effective runtime P2P latency.

qualification.p2p_payload_correctness: 702 full payload checks before and 702 after timed repeats
qualification.reducescatter_sum_status: Unqualified vendor BF16 SUM: tool disables correctness due to its input range. MAX controls are distinct and do not validate SUM.
qualification.graph_capture_status: Native P2P capture readiness returned ACL107025, retained as failed experiment; excluded from calibration.
qualification.timing: ACL events after a host-callback gate; prequeue all HCCL calls and release after an MPI barrier. Device timing excludes enqueue gaps; wall timing includes queue preparation. Half round trip includes HCCL protocol, not bare-wire propagation.

limits: Effective 4096-cube compute coefficients are not theoretical peaks; do not claim a strict SOL lower bound.
A scalar P2P formula misses protocol transitions: about58% error at256KiB; use native HCCL curves for accurate operator predictions.
No HCCL operator parquet/version mapping or HCCL serving-memory model is published.
No GLM-5.2 ModelSlim fused-kernel or end-to-end prediction accuracy qualification.
